sources.title: Jev (AI model) - Wikipedia

It was released in limited early access on 15 September 2026, alongside the announcement of a US$40 million seed round led by DCVC. sources.snippet: Machine learning classification algorithms are essential tools used to categorize data into predefined classes based on learned patterns. From simple linear models to advanced neural networks, these algorithms are used in applications like spam detection, image recognition, sentiment analysis and medical diagnosis.
